items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Or Louie Nelson or Piqu and Bach Kay, any of those men? ... [INTERVIEWEE] George A. Boyd, George A. Boyd. Oh yeah. I mean, he, well they didn't class him as a clarinet, but I thought he could play more than all of those.

ctx.x: Lorenzo Tio, but I didn't like him too well. Uh-uh.
Or Louie Nelson or Piqu and Bach Kay, any of those men? Some of those are left-handed.
George A. Boyd, George A. Boyd. Oh yeah. I mean, he, well they didn't class him as a clarinet, but I thought he could play more than all of those.
